title: Faraday cage test at the Monroe Institute

tellings.quote: So, we were at the Monurro Institute and they took me in the basement of the lab and put me in a Faraday cage

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says UFOs seem drawn to him, tells of a test in 2025 at the Monroe Institute, a centre in Virginia that studies consciousness. He says they took him down to the basement lab and put him inside a Faraday cage, a metal enclosure that blocks radio and electrical signals. The point would be to see whether whatever surrounds him still shows up once he is cut off from outside signals.
